transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well. It's kind of hard to explain. I guess... I've just been noticing things lately. 

I'm... I'm pretty convinced that one of my MBA classmates and this startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Like... certain comments they make in class, or... or Slack messages. They're like coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. 

So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Do you think it's possible that you're misinterpreting these comments and messages?

Um... I don't think so. 

I know it sounds... hard to explain to someone else. But I'm completely convinced it's happening. The things they say in class, and... the Slack messages. They just really seem like coded signals for me. I don't think I'm making it up.
How long have you been noticing these coded signals?

Um... about two months, I guess. 

It started... well, right around the time I began the part-time MBA prerequisite program. I've been doing that while still working my operations job, so... yeah. Since around then.
Do you have any other beliefs that you're absolutely convinced are true, but that others might not agree with?
Um... no. Not really. Just... just the things I mentioned about the signals. That's all.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely convinced were true, but that others might have thought were strange or unlikely?
No... I don't think so. Just what I already told you.
Has your belief about the coded signals been affecting your daily life or relationships in any way?

Um... I guess so. A little. I mean, I'm still showing up to everything. Work, classes... I'm there. 

But... yeah. My manager has started documenting some things lately. Like missed handoffs and... what she called unreliable follow-through. And then at school, my professor questioned my judgment on this group assignment we had. 

It's just... things are getting strained. My relationships with people at work and in my program are just... yeah. I guess it got to the point where I felt like I needed to come in and get some help.
Would you say the idea that your classmates and advisor are sending you coded signals is something that most people would believe if they were in your shoes?

Um... I don't know. Maybe not. I know it sounds... hard to explain. But I've just been completely convinced that they're coordinating things for me. Like... certain comments in class, or the Slack messages. I just... I really thought they were coded signals about my career. Where I'm supposed to go. But... I don't know if other people would see it that way. That's why I came in.
Have your feelings about the coded signals changed at all since you first started noticing them?

Um... I don't know. Not really. I just... like I said, I was completely convinced that my classmate and that startup advisor were quietly setting up opportunities for me. That all those messages were about where my career was supposed to go. I don't know if my feelings about it changed, exactly. I just... I guess I'm starting to second-guess it a little now.
Have you had any other thoughts that you were completely convinced were true, but might seem strange or unlikely to others, besides the coded signals?
Um... no. I don't think so. Just... just the things I already mentioned to you.
Would you describe the idea that your classmates and advisor are sending you coded signals as a strange or unusual belief?

I guess... yeah. I mean, I know it sounds unusual. That's... that's why I'm here. It's just hard to explain how real it feels... that my classmate and the advisor are coordinating things, sending those signals through Slack or in class about my career. But... yeah, I suppose it's strange to other people.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe in the coded signals?

Um... not really. I mean, since it started... I've just been completely convinced that they were coordinating things. Every time there was a certain comment in class, or... or a Slack message... I just knew it was a signal about my career. I didn't really doubt it until... well, recently. Like I said.
Have you ever believed something else to be true that might seem strange or unlikely to others, outside of the coded signals?
Um... no. Like I said a minute ago... it's just the signals. I haven't had any other thoughts like that. There isn't anything else.
Do you think the coded signals are part of a larger plan or scheme that involves other people or events beyond just your classmate and advisor?
No. It's... it's just them. Just the two of them. I don't think anyone else is involved.
Do you think the coded signals from your classmate and advisor are related to anything else that's happening in your life?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... it's just about my career, like I said. I don't think it has to do with anything else.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely convinced were true, but that you now realize might not be true?

I... I don't think so. I mean, the reason I came in is just because... well, I know it sounds hard to explain, but I've just been so completely convinced about my classmate and the startup advisor. Like I said, the way they coordinate opportunities for me... the Slack messages, the comments in class. I just... I really believed they were coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. But... I don't know, maybe I'm starting to wonder about it. But that's the only thing.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely convinced were true, but might seem strange or unlikely to others, at any point in your life?
Um... no. Not really. Just... just the stuff with the startup advisor and my classmate. I haven't really had anything else like that happen before.
Do you think the coded signals from your classmate and advisor fit into a broader, organized plan that makes sense to you?

Um... I don't know about a broader plan. It's just... like I said, I've just been really convinced that they're coordinating things for me. The comments and the Slack messages... they just felt like signals about my career. That's... that's really all it is. I don't know if it's some big organized thing. Just... what I already told you.
Have your beliefs about the coded signals changed significantly since you first noticed them?

Um... no, not really. They haven't changed. I'm just... I'm still just convinced that my classmate and the startup advisor are coordinating things for me. Like... the comments they make, the Slack messages. I still think they're coded signals about my career path. That's... that's why I came in, because I just... I know it sounds hard to explain to other people, but I still believe it's happening.
Have you ever had a period where you doubted the coded signals were real?

Um... no. Not really. I just... I know it sounds strange to other people, but I've just been completely convinced that it's real. That they're coordinating things for me. The comments and the messages... I just believe they're signals. I haven't really doubted it.
